title: ErrorResponse
description: The body of every 4xx and 5xx response from services/api (services/api/README.md): Fastify's error shape. The message is for people and never carries credentials, connection strings or private data.

code.description: A stable error code, when there is one (Fastify's own codes start with FST_).

error.description: The status code's reason phrase, for example Not Found.
